sourceProof.interval: All stations, metadata, main/romaji copies, path, train and line badge remain primary. Train centers lie on the fixed source polyline; its full footprint is enclosed by the convex Minkowski hull of all path vertices and the source half-width/height. Every possible current-station marker is enclosed by a source marker pad, while labels stay fixed. Badge outBack(s=1.9) support is bounded by scale [0,1.2]. Separate source-unit envelopes retain real gaps without dropping context or changing clocks.
sourceProof.stageProof: Each source route group retains all recorded primary polygon corners. Context also encloses every polyline vertex plus the full train footprint, station markers include every finite state, and badge support includes the full native outBack scale. All four axis corners are retained before camera hull construction.
sourceProof.limitations: Cut/still text motion only; unsupported source domains fail explicitly

quality.markerSupportProof: Current marker maximum dimensions plus widest source stroke and 1px AA enclose all finite current/ordinary states. Portrait 1px owned field guard is allocated from native raw gap >=4.08px, retaining marker AA clearance.
